cases.question: 这个平台采用哪一版教材？为什么 syllabus 上写的是第7版？
criteria: The instructor selected Power System Analysis and Design, sixth edition (2017), as the platform textbook basis on 2026-10-04.
The original Fall 2026 syllabus states seventh edition (2023); preserve that bibliographic fact and explain the separate platform selection.
Do not claim that the original syllabus PDF was changed or that this selection changed grading, dates or AI policy.

cases.question: 我可以用 AI 做作业和课程项目吗？
criteria: Use is allowed unless otherwise specified by instructor.
Students must understand, verify and explain submitted work, and disclose material AI assistance.
Do not invent a blanket ban or blanket permission for exams.

cases.question: 课程成绩由哪些部分组成？
criteria: Three exams and design project each 100 points, homework 50, attendance 20.
Preserve the separate project-score qualification and possible adjustments; do not invent percentage cutoffs beyond the source.

cases.question: 第7版第2章第51题的题目是什么？
criteria: The platform uses the sixth edition; seventh-edition exercise text has not been imported.
Do not substitute the sixth-edition problem with the same number.
Ask for the actual seventh-edition problem text or a source in that edition. Its absence does not block preparation of the selected sixth edition.

cases.question: 那第6版第2章第51题呢？有第6版是不是就一定能给出这道题？
criteria: The selected edition is six, so its exercise identities are the default platform basis.
Edition compatibility is distinct from exercise coverage and transcription accuracy; retrieve the actual exercise text before answering.
Do not invent an exercise when its text is quarantined, missing or unverified; ask for the exact text if needed.

cases.question: 教材的169.7 V和120 V为什么都正确？相位会改变吗？
criteria: Peak and RMS differ by sqrt(2), while the cosine phase is retained.
The textbook example has 60 degrees; do not mix it with the L05 example's 30 degrees.
Cite sixth-edition printed p.41 / PDF p.61 and preserve rounded values.

cases.question: 为什么复功率要用电流的共轭？
criteria: With current into the element and RMS phasors, S=VI*, giving voltage phase minus current phase.
Preserve passive current reference, P/Q units and lagging-load reactive-power sign.

cases.question: 教材用线对中性点电压算Zbase，网页用线电压，是不是矛盾？
criteria: For balanced three-phase bases, S3phi=3 S1phi and VLL=sqrt(3) VLN.
VLL squared / total three-phase S equals VLN squared / per-phase S.
Do not mix total power with phase voltage; label the bridge as a supplemental derivation.

cases.question: L03和L04的fuel mix是不是教材第6章的经济调度？
criteria: Syllabus assigns Optimal Fuel Mix Analysis to Supplement.
Economic dispatch can be related background, but do not invent a required textbook section for these lectures.

cases.question: capital_cost_AEO2025这个文件是2025年的成本报告吗？
criteria: Cover publication date is January 2024 despite archive filename.
Retain report year, dollar-year assumptions and units; do not present as current 2026 prices.

cases.question: overnight capital cost包含建设期的利息吗？
criteria: The source excludes interest accrued during plant construction and development.
Keep this distinct from fuel and ongoing operating cost.
Cite the dated EIA source rather than inventing current price figures.

cases.question: 为什么要除以根号2？任何波形都可以这样算 RMS 吗？
criteria: Use the full-period mean of squared voltage and cos squared identity for a zero-offset sinusoid.
The peak/sqrt(2) rule is not valid for arbitrary waveforms or a sinusoid with DC offset.
Distinguish a source formula from the supplemental heating/integral explanation.

cases.question: 相量没有时间，怎么还原成随时间变化的电压？
criteria: Reconstruct v(t)=Re{sqrt(2) Vphasor exp(j omega t)} for an RMS phasor.
The imaginary coordinate is a representation, not an additional physical voltage.
Do not sum different frequencies as one phasor with a shared time factor.

cases.question: 为什么代码用 atan2，零相量的角度是多少？
criteria: atan2(imaginary, real) retains quadrant information; atan(imaginary/real) alone does not.
A zero vector has no unique angle; avoid inventing a physical zero-degree direction.
Identify these details as course-derived explanations of the source representation.

cases.question: 为什么电感电流滞后90度，电容电流超前90度？
criteria: Use ideal constant elements in sinusoidal steady state, RMS phasors and current into the positive terminal.
I_L=V/(j omega L) and I_C=j omega C V; capacitor reactance magnitude is positive but its impedance is negative imaginary.
These pure-element angles are not universal for mixed loads or transients.
